_comment: One-line meaning for every trace format, keyed by TRC_ enum; consumed by gen_formats.py, which refuses to run if any format lacks one.
TRC_LOGMAG: Magnitude in dB: 20·log₁₀|S|. Return loss for S11 (more negative = better match), insertion loss/gain for S21.
TRC_PHASE: Phase of S11 or S21 in degrees, −180…+180 (wraps).
TRC_DELAY: Group delay: −dφ/dω, the rate of phase change with frequency, in seconds. Sensitive to noise on S11.
TRC_SMITH: Smith chart of S11 (or S21): the complex reflection coefficient on the impedance grid; marker readout selectable (R+jX, R+L/C, admittance, …).
TRC_POLAR: Polar plot of the complex S-parameter: magnitude as radius, phase as angle, with no impedance grid.
TRC_LINEAR: Linear magnitude |S| (0…1 for a passive S11).
TRC_SWR: Standing-wave ratio from |S11|: (1+|Γ|)/(1−|Γ|). 1.0 is a perfect match; the grid's bottom line is 1.0.
TRC_REAL: Real part of the S-parameter (Re Γ).
TRC_IMAG: Imaginary part of the S-parameter (Im Γ).
TRC_R: Series resistance R of the impedance Z = R + jX seen at the port, in ohms.
TRC_X: Series reactance X of Z = R + jX, in ohms; negative = capacitive, positive = inductive, zero at resonance.
TRC_ZPHASE: Impedance phase angle: atan2(X, R) in degrees.
TRC_G: Conductance G of the admittance Y = G + jB, in siemens.
TRC_B: Susceptance B of Y = G + jB, in siemens.
TRC_Rp: Parallel-equivalent resistance Rp (the impedance modelled as Rp in parallel with a reactance), in ohms.
TRC_Cs: Series-equivalent capacitance derived from X (valid where X is capacitive), in farads.
TRC_Ls: Series-equivalent inductance derived from X (valid where X is inductive), in henries.
TRC_Cp: Parallel-equivalent capacitance derived from B, in farads.
TRC_Lp: Parallel-equivalent inductance derived from B, in henries.
TRC_Q: Quality factor of the series impedance, |X| / R.
TRC_Rser: Resistance of a device measured in series between the ports (S21 series-through method), in ohms.
TRC_Xser: Reactance of a series-through device, in ohms.
TRC_Zser: Impedance magnitude of a series-through device, in ohms.
TRC_Rsh: Resistance of a device measured as a shunt across the through path (S21 shunt method), in ohms.
TRC_Xsh: Reactance of a shunt device, in ohms.
TRC_Zsh: Impedance magnitude of a shunt device, in ohms.
TRC_Qs21: Quality factor from the S21 series/shunt measurement, |X| / R.
TRC_SWR_ANT: SWR at the far end of the feedline: |S11| corrected for the one-way cable loss entered under CABLE LOSS (or computed from CABLE TYPE and CABLE LENGTH on the H4). Blank until a loss is set; see the README's SWR ANT section.
